claim_summary: Zeta2.1 becomes the default edit-prediction model; vendor reports average output tokens ~270 to ~90 and p50 latency 189 ms to 136 ms versus Zeta2; described as open-weight and trained on opt-in open-source data.

source_title: Zed IDE Arbitrary Code Execution via untrusted repository with poisoned .git/config (CVE-2026-44465)
claim_summary: High-severity advisory: opening a folder whose .git/config sets core.fsmonitor could execute commands even in untrusted mode; patched in v0.227.1 and later.
availability: fix in v0.227.1 (a pre-window version); advisory published in window
limitation: Advisory publication date is not the discovery or fix date; affected-user count and exploitation unknown.

source_title: Allowlist Bypass via Environment Variable Injection in Terminal Tool Permissions (CVE-2026-44463)
claim_summary: Three same-day advisories (CVE-2026-44463 high, CVE-2026-44462 medium, CVE-2026-44466 high) describe bypasses of the agent terminal-tool command allowlist via inline env-var prefixes, ${var@P} expansion and arithmetic expansion; patched in v0.229.0 and later.
availability: fix in v0.229.0 (pre-window version); advisories published in window
limitation: One row for three advisories; the second URL is the same vendor's advisory, not an independent check; regex allowlists are not an OS security boundary.

source_title: Remote Command Injection via Unquoted Environment Variable Keys (SSH / WSL Remote) (CVE-2026-44461)
claim_summary: High-severity advisory: terminal env keys from project .zed/settings.json were not quoted in SSH/WSL remote command strings, allowing command execution on the remote host; patched in v0.227.1 and later.
availability: fix in v0.227.1 (pre-window version); advisory published in window
limitation: Reporter-supplied proof of concept not reproduced here; advisory date is not fix date.
